shortBio.en: Oasis lead vocalist; sneering mid-range delivery; later Beady Eye and solo work.
shortBio.zh: Oasis 主唱；冷笑中音区唱法；后有 Beady Eye 与独唱。

whyHub.en: Frontman as attitude engine; the Noel feud is historical material, not only tabloid noise.
whyHub.zh: 作为态度引擎的主唱；与 Noel 的争执是历史材料，不只是小报噪音。

body.en:
Born 1972. Voice of Live Forever / Wonderwall–era Oasis—nasal attack, parked microphone stance. After Oasis, Beady Eye and solo albums keep the vocal moving while the classic lineup stays archived.

Hub page exists so sibling-feud tropes point to people, not vague vibes.
body.zh:
1972 年生。Live Forever / Wonderwall 时期 Oasis 的声线——鼻音攻击、麦克风架姿势。Oasis 之后，Beady Eye 与独唱专辑让声线继续，经典阵容留在档案。

枢纽页存在是为了让兄弟争执原型指向具体人物，而非模糊氛围。
